segment_contamination_dimensions: Residential and leisure accommodation buyers (Log Homes, Container Homes, Prefabricated Guest House, Modular Cottages, Portable Resort, Prefabricated Beach House, Tree House, Bamboo Huts) — these buyers seek permanent or semi-permanent living/hospitality structures, not temporary industrial site offices; names implying home, guest house, resort, cottage, or leisure use are blocked.

General worker sleeping-quarters bunkhouse buyers (Bunkhouses, MS Bunkhouse) — these buyers seek dormitory-style accommodation cabins without the office/workspace function; names that drop the office/workspace context and imply pure sleeping accommodation are blocked to avoid overlap with sibling MCATs 23898 and 150851.
Security and guard post buyers (Guard Huts, PVC Guard Huts) — these buyers seek small single-post security enclosures; names implying guard hut, sentry post, or security cabin are blocked.

Wooden and log construction buyers (Log Homes, Log Cabin, Prefabricated Wooden House, Wooden House) — these buyers seek timber-frame or log-based structures; names implying wooden or log construction are blocked as they attract an incompatible material-segment buyer.

Prefab Steel Bunk House (sibling MCAT 133097) — exact trade name 'Prefab Steel Bunk House' is a live sibling name and is blocked from use as an enhanced name variant; it is retained only in trade_names alt_names bucket as a recognised trade term buyers search.
